SUMMARY

Results-driven Business Analyst with 7 years in global cards

and payments, specializing in GPP and ISO 20022 migration.

Expertise in requirements gathering, stakeholder

management, and delivering solutions across complex

payment ecosystems. Experience in Retail Banking focusing

on transaction lifecycle management and scalable,

customer-centric solutions.

EXPERIENCE

Oct 2022 — Current

Product Owner

FINASTRA, Pune, India

Led end-to-end implementation of GPP (Global

Payments Platform), ensuring seamless integration with

core banking systems.

Hands-on experience in ISO 20022 migration, including

message mapping, validation, and compliance with

SWIFT standards.

Hands-on expertise in SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area)

payment processing, ensuring compliance with European

regulatory standards.

Strong knowledge of digital payments, cross-border

transactions, and real-time payment systems.

Expertise in transaction lifecycle management – from

initiation, authorization, clearing, to settlement.

Expertise in developing jars in internal interface for MX

conversion.

Conducted requirement gathering, gap analysis, and

functional specification creation for global payments

projects.

Worked on FRSD documentation, specific to a particular

client.

Owned and prioritized product backlog.

Collaborated with development and engineering teams

to guide product development and maintain project

timelines.

Supported agile methodology adoption across teams,

fostering a culture of continuous improvement and

adaptability within the organization.

Prioritized and tracked defects using the bug tracking

tool Jira.

Supported UAT, defect management, and production

rollout for large-scale payment transformation initiatives.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define

product vision and requirements.

Facilitated sprint planning sessions to align team efforts

with project goals.

Developed user stories, acceptance criteria, and mockups

for new features.

Delivered training and support for users during the

product lifecycle.

Developed process documentation related to product life

cycle management.

Apr 2022 — Sep 2022

IT Business Analyst

Capgemini, Pune

Gathered client requirements and prioritized deliverables,

Business Requirements Document (BRD), and Functional

Specification Document (FSD) for smooth project release.

Published user stories to enhance CG proprietary

Payment Hub Framework.

Reviewed SWIFT messages such as MT103, MT202, MT940,

and MT942, along with ISO 20022 messages like

PACS.008, PACS.009, CAMT.054, and CAMT.053.

Collaborated with CG Payments CoPs on ISO20022 and

Payment Hub initiatives.

Prepared materials for the Learning Development team

to migrate from older formats to ISO20022 messages.

Oct 2020 — Jan 2022

Academic Counselor

Vedantu, Pune

Collaborated with product and sales teams to align

academic counseling strategies with Vedantu’s digital

learning solutions, ensuring seamless student

onboarding and adoption of the platform.

Supported product growth by driving enrollments

through counseling sessions, directly contributing to

revenue targets and platform expansion.

May 2019 — Oct 2020

Deputy Manager

ICICI Bank, Ahmedabad

Developed and implemented strategies for top-tier

customer service.

Oversaw branch operation and workflow for consistency.

Managed operational tasks and transactions at the

branch

EDUCATION

Jul 2012 — Jul 2016

B.Tech, Electronics And Telecommunications

RSRRCET, Bhilai

Jul 2017 — Jun 2019

PGDM

ISBS, Pune

PROJECTS

Successfully contributed to the CHIPS ISO Migration

project in collaboration with HSBC, BRCL, and MANT

Bank, ensuring smooth transition of payment messaging

standards to ISO 20022.

Additionally worked on the FED ISO Migration initiative

with the same set of banks, focusing on harmonizing

cross-border payment formats and enhancing

interoperability.

Currently leading and managing CBPR+, CHIPS, and FED

2026 regulatory change implementations across HSBC,

BRCL, and MANT Bank, ensuring compliance with

evolving global payment regulations.

Responsibilities included requirement gathering, impact

analysis, stakeholder coordination, and end-to-end

delivery of migration activities, while mitigating

operational risks and ensuring business continuity.

Capgemini, Pune
Gathered client requirements and prioritized deliverables,

Published user stories to enhance CG proprietary
Payment Hub Framework.
Reviewed SWIFT messages such as MT103, MT202, MT940,
and MT942, along with ISO 20022 messages like

Prepared materials for the Learning Development team

Academic Counselor
Vedantu, Pune

Supported product growth by driving enrollments

Deputy Manager
ICICI Bank, Ahmedabad

branch

project in collaboration with HSBC, BRCL, and MANT
Bank, ensuring smooth transition of payment messaging
standards to ISO 20022.

with the same set of banks, focusing on harmonizing
cross-border payment formats and enhancing
interoperability.

2026 regulatory change implementations across HSBC,
BRCL, and MANT Bank, ensuring compliance with
evolving global payment regulations.
Responsibilities included requirement gathering, impact
analysis, stakeholder coordination, and end-to-end
delivery of migration activities, while mitigating
operational risks and ensuring business continuity.
